facts.fact: The High Constitutional Court's decision of 27 January 2017 declares Law 2016-056 of 16 December 2016 on electronic money and e-money institutions, adopted by both chambers on 14 and 16 December 2016, in conformity with the Constitution before promulgation; it states Madagascar's positive law held no e-money provisions until then.
facts.system: Loi n°2016-056 sur la monnaie électronique et les établissements de monnaie électronique

facts.fact: The decision states that under Law 2016-056 all e-money operations must go through an e-money institution licensed by the CSBF (banking and financial supervision commission), the regulator of those institutions, with disciplinary and penal sanctions for breach.
facts.system: Loi n°2016-056 sur la monnaie électronique et les établissements de monnaie électronique
